Reference image: Glep, the small green character wearing a purple pointed witch hat. Preserve his recognizable silhouette: light green skin, huge single visible white eye with black pupil, wide sideways mouth/snout, long floppy purple pointed hat. Full body standing, facing left, arms close to body as if hiding, curious slightly alarmed expression. Detailed but genuinely chunky low-resolution pixel art as if drawn on a 64 by 96 pixel grid, hard square edges, nearest-neighbor look, no antialiasing. Restrained colors and subtle cool shadow pixels suitable for a dim industrial sci-fi laboratory. Keep the face recognizable when displayed at 40-70 pixels high. Tight framing around the entire sprite, transparent background. The website will partially hide his lower body behind furniture.
